item.title: New Walk in GP Clinic Confirmed for Moray This Summer
item.description: A new walk in GP clinic will open in Moray this summer, offering on the day care from 12pm to 8pm and forming part of a national expansion expected to deliver over one million additional appointments.The post New Walk in GP Clinic Confirmed for Moray This Summer appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Maree Todd Urges Jamie Stone to Back Rural Banking Hub Petition
item.description: Maree Todd has urged Jamie Stone to back her petition seeking reform of banking hub rules, arguing rural communities across the Highlands risk financial exclusion under current criteria.The post Maree Todd Urges Jamie Stone to Back Rural Banking Hub Petition appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Committee Warns Cairngorm Funicular Costs May Outweigh Benefits
item.description: A Scottish Parliament committee has warned that the ongoing costs of the Cairngorm Funicular may outweigh its economic benefits, calling for greater transparency and clearer governance of the publicly funded project.The post Committee Warns Cairngorm Funicular Costs May Outweigh Benefits appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Historic 300 Year Old Clachaig Inn in Glencoe Goes on The Market
item.description: The 300 year old Clachaig Inn in Glencoe has been placed on the market for £3,800,000, bringing to sale one of the Highlands’ most iconic and historic inns.The post Historic 300 Year Old Clachaig Inn in Glencoe Goes on The Market appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Liberal Democrats Launch Fix Our Highland Roads Campaign
item.description: Highland Liberal Democrats have launched a petition calling for a dedicated roads funding plan after councillors were told the region faces a £233 million repair backlog.The post Highland Liberal Democrats Launch Fix Our Highland Roads Campaign appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Poll Puts SNP on Course for Majority at Holyrood
item.description: A new MRP poll suggests the SNP could win 67 seats at Holyrood, putting the party on course for a majority as Keith Brown says a “fresh start with independence” is there to be won.The post New Poll Puts SNP on Course for Majority at Holyrood appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Rhoda Grant Presses Highland Council Over Women’s Aid Funding Silence
item.description: Rhoda Grant has said Highland Council has yet to respond to cross party calls for urgent talks on funding for Women’s Aid services, as MSPs press for clarity and assurances over future support. The post Rhoda Grant Presses Highland Council Over Women’s Aid Funding Silence appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Rare Mountain Fern Given New Chance on Glen Affric Slope
item.description: A rare mountain fern once pushed to the brink of extinction has been replanted in Glen Affric as part of a national recovery effort to restore threatened native species across Scotland. The post Rare Mountain Fern Given New Chance on Glen Affric Slope appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Green Freeports Share £700,000 to Drive Highland and Forth Investment
item.description: Scotland’s two Green Freeports have secured £700,000 in UK Government funding to advance key Highland and Forth projects, supporting pre construction planning aimed at unlocking jobs, investment and long term economic growth.The post Scottish Green Freeports Share £700,000 to Drive Highland and Forth Investment appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Hospitality Leaders Launch National Campaign to Halt Rates Hike
item.description: Scotland’s hospitality sector has launched a national campaign urging ministers to halt planned rates increases until the Gill Review concludes, warning that family run restaurants, pubs and hotels are being pushed from growth into survival.The post Hospitality Leaders Launch National Campaign to Halt Rates Hike appeared first on The Highland Times.
